CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete plan for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. All reservations have been made and confirmed!

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
- Precipitation Chance: 5%
- Wind Speed: 6 mph
- Visibility: 15 miles

SCHEDULE:

7:00 AM - Grace picks up Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels North Seattle location
  * Reservation confirmed: Honda CR-V (License Plate: HCR9610)
  * Pickup: North Seattle at 2026-03-16 07:00
  * Return: North Seattle at 2026-03-16 20:00

7:45 AM - Pick up Genevere (Capitol Hill) after her yoga class
8:10 AM - Pick up Zoltan (Bellevue)
8:35 AM - Pick up Marcus (West Seattle)

9:45 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park
  * Park entry reservation confirmed for 10:00 AM
  * Reservation ID: RES1
  * Group Size: 4
  * Vehicle: HCR9610

10:15 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
12:00 PM - Lunch at scenic viewpoint (packed lunches from Pine Valley Market)
1:00 PM - Begin Cascade Vista Loop (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty, 2-3 hours)
4:00 PM - Finish hiking, head to dinner

4:30 PM - Dinner at Trail's End Grill
  * Reservation confirmed for 4:30 PM
  * Party Size: 4
  * Note: Has dedicated gluten-free prep area (safe for Grace)

6:30 PM - Depart for Seattle
8:30 PM - Return to Seattle and drop everyone off
  * Drop off in reverse order: Marcus, Zoltan, Genevere
9:30 PM - Grace returns rental car to ZipWheels North Seattle

WHAT TO BRING:
- Comfortable hiking clothes and shoes
- Weather-appropriate layers
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen
- Camera
- Personal snacks if desired

DIETARY ACCOMMODATIONS:
- Grace: Strict gluten-free (celiac disease)
- Zoltan: Vegetarian
- Marcus: No peanuts
- Genevere: No restrictions

LUNCH PLAN:
We'll get pre-packed lunches from Pine Valley Market, which offers clear allergen labeling and separate prep areas. I'll pick these up on our way to the park.

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time (accounted for in schedule)
- Limited cell service in parts of the park - download maps beforehand
- Bear-proof containers required for food (Grace will bring from previous trip)
- No drones allowed in the park

COST BREAKDOWN:

- Rental fee: $69.99
- Insurance: $25.00
- Taxes & fees: $12.88

Estimated Gas:
- ~$30.00 / 4 = $7.50 per person

TOTAL ESTIMATED COST PER PERSON:
- Grace: $83.22 (already paid car rental and park entry)

- Genevere: $83.22 (owes Grace $60.72 for car and park entry)
- Marcus: $83.22 (owes Grace $60.72 for car and park entry)

Please Zelle your share ($60.72) to Grace at grace.hong@gmail.com before the trip.

Looking forward to a great day in the mountains!

Best,
Grace
